title: Docs: Meta's "Project Gryffindor" initiative in 2024 to acquire new teen Instagram users included school directories, banners, and "school blast" notifications (Katie McQue/NPR)
summary: Katie McQue / NPR: Docs: Meta's “Project Gryffindor” initiative in 2024 to acquire new teen Instagram users included school directories, banners, and “school blast” notifications — Internal Meta documents show the company planned to boost Instagram use among teens by targeting schools …
